purpose: Local corrected-v2 development reward qualification, before ranking
simulator_identity: candidate for compatibility only; historical benchmark revision unknown
recording_boundary: timestep resets to zero and prior row is done or truncated; never treat a continuing terminal flag as a new recording
horizon_indices: 0 through 249 inclusive; a kept cutoff row is a timeout
terminal_handling: first compute_termination row retained with zero reward; later rows of that recording excluded; timeout final row has zero reward under set_terminals=True; no bootstrap
start_distribution: eligible observed real recording starts after registered bad-trajectory exclusion, selected by whole recording; no real-simulation episode pairing assumed
progress_input: decode each archive's progress_sin/progress_cos with atan2 modulo one; check real stored progress separately

reward_definitions.progress: 100 times positive forward wrapped progress increment from row i to i+1; final included row zero
reward_definitions.min_act: one minus squared (previous_action_steer plus delta steering)/0.4189; terminal row zero
reward_definitions.checkpoint: 10 per newly crossed strict 0.1-lap checkpoint, zero at stationary final row; source fast_reward.py's progress[-1]=3 side effect is excluded and reported as a source discrepancy

aggregation: discounted sum per whole retained recording using 0.99**row_index; unweighted arithmetic mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0) across recordings per policy and archive; no pooling of rows or invented pairs
